profile_text.body:
Seagate Technology Holdings plc is a public company headquartered in Singapore and traded under the ticker STX. Its own site describes it as a leader in mass-capacity data storage, saying it has delivered more than four billion terabytes of capacity over the past four decades. The company says it makes storage that scales and that it brings trust and integrity to innovations that depend on data.

Much of the site's current messaging centers on AI. Seagate says AI is accelerating data growth and reshaping storage requirements, and it points readers toward assessing their organization's readiness and building a storage strategy for performance, scale, and growth. The company says it is optimizing storage for AI, describing capacity gains aimed at supporting efficient data center architecture and buildout, and it frames the coming period as one in which people and machines create data in more ways and at a faster pace than before.

The company's profile lists a Central Index Key of 0001137789 and the aliases Seagate Technology Holdings plc and SEAGATE TECHNOLOGY HOLDINGS.
